dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical bulge on the right lateral margin compared to the smoother convex left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with light grey undertones visible across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, faint grey mottling appearing as diffuse clusters on the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual gradient between grey mottled regions and the white baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple linear, high-contrast white rake marks distributed diagonally and longitudinally across the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the dorsal area, likely from conspecific interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly defined, prominent dorsal ridge extending along the central longitudinal axis.
